config.title: FUNDA — Multi-step Form Wizard

intro.title: FUNDA — Multi-step Form Wizard
intro.body: In this lesson you will build a Multi-step Form Wizard — an onboarding flow split across three named steps (Account Details → Company Info → Plan Selection) with a progress indicator, back/next navigation, step-level validation that prevents advancing with invalid data, and an "unsaved changes" warning when the user tries to navigate away mid-wizard. You will maintain each step as its own FormGroup, merge them into a single payload on final submission, and protect the wizard route with a canDeactivate guard that checks for dirty form state before allowing navigation away.
intro.usecase: Multi-step wizards appear in every enterprise onboarding, checkout, configuration, and application flow. canDeactivate is the correct tool for preventing accidental data loss when the user navigates away.

objectives: Create three independent FormGroups (one per step) and manage the active step index as a Signal or local component state
Prevent advancing to the next step by checking the current step's FormGroup validity and marking all controls as touched to show errors
Merge all three FormGroup values into a single submission payload and POST it on the final step's submit action
Implement a functional canDeactivate guard that returns a confirmation Observable when the wizard has unsaved (dirty) changes
Store the partially completed wizard state in sessionStorage so refreshing the page restores the user's progress
Emit step-level data from child step components to the parent wizard via @Output EventEmitter without a shared service
Display a step progress indicator that marks steps as complete, current, or pending based on the active step index
